==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

[[Elaida]] comes into the room and acts very arrogantly to Egwene, [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]]. She asks if they know of the [[Black Ajah]], and the girls confirm that they do. She asks where they have been so she can protect them from being linked to [[Liandrin]] and the other sisters that fled the tower. The girls decline to disclose where they have been, with Nynaeve claiming that the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]] had told them not to disclose it. Elaida shifts the conversation to ask about [[Rand]]. As Nynaeve ponders how to answer, the door opens again and [[Sheriam]] walks in. Sheriam wants all three of them to go with her and faces Elaida down until she leaves. Nynaeve asks about the [[Gray Man]] so Sheriam realizes they have told Elayne despite orders to tell no one. She repeats that they are not to speak of it except to the Amyrlin. She says the [[Healing]] of someone brought to the Tower is always done in the presence of those who brought him; they are to follow her to [[Mat Cauthon|Mat]]'s [[Healing]].
